biggest_catch: The $150 annual fee comes out of the bonus: $2,000 cash after $30,000 in 3 months minus the $150 fee leaves $1,850 net — but $30,000 in 3 months is $10,000/month of business spend, only sensible with already-planned business purchases; the fee is refunded each year only if the business spends $150,000+ annually.
catches: Claim the bonus only with business spending you already planned; never manufacture $30,000 of spend just for the bonus.
The $150 annual fee reduces the bonus — first-year net math is in the biggest catch above. The fee is refunded via a $150 statement credit each year the business spends $150,000+ in net purchases.
Applying for the card causes a hard credit inquiry (plus business underwriting), which can temporarily affect your credit.
The variable purchase APR is 25.74% — carrying a balance on a $30,000 run would wipe out the bonus; pay in full.
The bonuses may not be available to existing or previous Capital One Business card holders — Capital One's business-card exclusion rule.
Capital One's official page does not state a specific bonus-posting window for this card, so there is no guaranteed payout date; cash rewards don't expire for the life of the account.
The two bonuses ($2,000 welcome + $2,000 per $500K in year one) may be earned independently — you can earn one or both.

steps: Go to the official Capital One page https://www.capitalone.com/small-business/credit-cards/lp/xs/spark-cash-plus/ and read the bonus terms ($2,000 after $30,000 in 3 months; extra $2,000 per $500K in year one).
Confirm you are not an existing or previous Capital One Business card holder — the bonus may not be available to you otherwise.
Apply online through that official page with your business information and get approved.
Within the first 3 months, route $30,000 of already-planned business purchases through the card — never manufacture spend for the bonus.
Pay the full balance by each due date — the variable APR is 25.74% and carrying a balance destroys the bonus math.
Track the cash rewards in your Capital One business account; the page gives no guaranteed posting date, so confirm the $2,000 appears before relying on it.
If annual business spend reaches $150,000+, confirm the $150 annual-fee statement credit lands after your membership anniversary.
timing: Capital One does not state a specific posting window for this bonus; cash rewards do not expire for the life of the account.
